criterionOutcomes.criterion: The map layer selector includes Service as a selectable layer.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-automobile-config.png, criterion-1-service-choice.png and criterion-1-final.png show Service offered and selected within Automobile Test type.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With Service unselected, the map displays no Service test-result points.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-service-unselected.png and criterion-2-final.png show the settled map with only Automobile - Ping selected and its legend; no Service layer or Service result points are displayed in the visible viewport. Existing HTTP Browsing details are unrelated.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When the user selects Service and matching authorised results are available, each matching result is displayed as a selectable map point.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-before-add-service.png shows Automobile Service selection; criterion-3-final.png shows the added Service layer, legend and populated markers; criterion-3-final-selected.png shows marker selection opening Service tests. Recorded GET /api/platform/automobile/service/points and POST /api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details returned 200. Evidence samples the visible viewport.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When the user selects a Service result point and its details load successfully, a Service details dialog displays MSISDN, Test Time, Signal, Band, Service, Data Technology, PLMN and Serving Cell.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-4-before-select-point.png and criterion-4-final.png show Service marker selection opening a docked details table containing all eight required headings and returned rows. Signal, PLMN and Serving Cell are N/A for the sampled out-of-service records; details are presented in a docked panel.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With the Service details table displayed, sorting a supported column reorders the displayed rows according to that column.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-5-before-sort.png shows descending Test Time rows from 12/10/2026 19:47:32; criterion-5-final.png shows the ascending indicator and increasing rows from 15/08/2026 15:37:13, 15:37:19 and 15:37:24. The criterion-owned comparison demonstrates reordering.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With the Service details table displayed, filtering a supported column limits the displayed rows to those matching the filter.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-6-before-filter.png shows multiple Service rows with differing Test Times; criterion-6-final.png shows filter 19:47:32 and only the matching 12/10/2026 19:47:32 row. The provided table-wide filter matches the supported Test Time column.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When returned details include cell-neighbour data, the dialog displays each neighbour in its own labelled details table.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-7-before-earliest-record.png shows the selected 15/08/2026 15:37:13 record. criterion-7-final-earliest-record.png and criterion-7-final-all-neighbours.png together show separately labelled Cell Neighbour 1, 2 and 3 tables, matching the three returned neighbours recorded for 131974812: RSRP -120/-118/-128 dBm, RSRQ -18/-16/-20, EARFCN 6400/6400/39448, PCI 117/272/62.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: While Service details are loading, the dialog displays a loading state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: The original development-host POST https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details read for pointId 132762383 / mercatorKey 1008808500521866559 was held and released, using its genuine 200 baseline as endpoint provenance. criterion-8-genuine-baseline.png and criterion-8-before-delayed-reopen.png establish loaded and closed states; criterion-8-final.png visibly shows a small blue loading spinner in the selected Service detail panel, rather than visible Loading point details text. criterion-8-recovery.png shows the same 19:47:32 record restored. Results document exact owned-handler removal and settled pending work. This proves the explicit loading UI only, not backend performance or manufactured backend success.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: If Service details cannot be retrieved, the dialog displays an error state and does not display stale details.
criterionOutcomes.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: A browser-local HTTP 503 application/problem+json response was injected only for the previously genuine development-host POST https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details read, pointId 132762383 / mercatorKey 1008808500521866559. criterion-9-target-genuine-baseline.png shows target 19:47:32; criterion-9-distinct-record-baseline.png shows prior record 132762320 at 19:47:26; criterion-9-before-failing-target.png returns to the list. criterion-9-final.png shows Unable to load point details and Retry with no prior details in the active target panel; the prior record is an inactive tab. criterion-9-recovery.png restores target 19:47:32 after Retry. Results document exact handler removal and settled work; criterion-9-cleanup.png shows restored Ping/HTTP Browsing state. This proves synthetic error UI handling only, not a real backend outage.

reason: Independent review of all nine canonical criteria for Automobile Service, cycle-002 attempt-001; simulated loading/error checks retain their UI-only limitations.
